# Simple pricing for world-builders

> Start free. Upgrade when you're ready to publish more, build together, or go live. On every plan, your worlds are yours.

## Free — $0 forever
For opening a playbox and beaming your first world.
- 1 published world
- Community profile
- Browser authoring
- Watermarked exports

## Creator — $19 /month {badge:Most Popular}
For artists shipping living worlds regularly.
- Everything in Free, plus

- Custom profile handle

## Studio — $49 /month
For crews and communities composing worlds together.
